units.source_text: 鬼卒们齐声说：“是”，便拿着铁鞭围上去，对两匹可怜的瘦马毫不留情的痛下狠手。

en.t: The demon guards answered in unison, "Yes," then took up iron whips, closed in, and mercilessly lashed the two poor, thin horses.

units.source_text: 鞭声清脆，如雨点般密集，所到之处伤痕累累。

en.t: The crack of the whips rang sharp and close as raindrops, leaving every place they struck covered with wounds.

units.source_text: 沦为牲畜的父母，两匹可怜的瘦马痛苦的忍受，血泪浮现，声声哀鸣，令人无不动容。

en.t: The parents who had been reduced to livestock, those two poor, thin horses, endured the pain as bloody tears welled up and each mournful neigh moved everyone who saw them.
